title: Handling and steering performance
summary: Feedback about handling and performance is mostly favorable, highlighting strong steering feel and confident driving dynamics, while many other mentions are too brief to classify beyond noting the topic.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise handling as very good to excellent, often alongside precise steering, strong suspension, and an enjoyable driving feel.

negative.summary: The negative feedback says the handling is not good, with no further detail in the sample.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions refer to handling as nice, easy to get used to, or light and precise, but the sample does not provide enough context to classify the overall sentiment reliably.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short, which limits the ability to identify specific handling attributes or classify sentiment with confidence.
The undetermined examples include positive-sounding wording, so the topic contains substantial ambiguity between explicit praise and insufficient-context mentions.
The evidence is drawn from a stratified sample and is not a representative estimate of all reviews.
